description: ADP: Android DevTools Protocol (docs/04-adp.md). CDP-style domains, commands, events, types. The version is contracts/adp/VERSION. Only shapes the docs and owner decisions fully define are listed. 64-bit integers are JSON decimal strings: type string with format int64 or uint64. 32-bit and smaller integers are JSON numbers: type integer, with format uint32 or int32 where the width is fixed. Type binary is a base64 string (RFC 4648 section 4, with padding), as in CDP. Extensions to the CDP structure: errors, envelope, scope on commands and events, format, discriminator/variants on tagged unions, nullable on optional properties (explicit null clears the field).

errors.name: FRAME_EXPIRED
errors.description: The requested frameId is no longer in the ring buffer. No other frame is substituted.

errors.name: NOT_ACTIONABLE
errors.description: The action cannot be performed on the target.

errors.name: POLICY_DENIED
errors.description: Denied by policy, including an Authorizer denial at attach.

errors.name: UNAUTHENTICATED
errors.description: The credential is missing or invalid, or a message arrived before authentication.

errors.name: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
errors.description: No protocol version both sides support.

errors.name: INVALID_REQUEST
errors.description: The envelope is malformed: not a Request object, an id that is not an integer in range or duplicates an in-flight request, a sessionId missing on a session-scoped or present on a connection-scoped method, or a message the connection state does not allow (before authentication: UNAUTHENTICATED).

errors.name: METHOD_NOT_FOUND
errors.description: The method names no command of this protocol version.

errors.name: INVALID_PARAMS
errors.description: The params do not follow the definition: a missing required value, a wrong type, an unknown enum value, an unknown union kind, a selector syntax error or unknown selector engine, an unknown diff format.

envelope.description: WebSocket text messages carry one JSON object each: Request (client to server), Response (server to client, one per Request), Event (server to client). Binary messages: see binary.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Non-negative integer, at most 2^53-1. Unique among the in-flight requests of the connection; otherwise INVALID_REQUEST.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: Absent for connection-scoped commands. Required for session-scoped commands. Otherwise INVALID_REQUEST.

types.description: Exactly one of result and error is present.

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: Present when the Request had one.

properties.name: code
properties.description: One of errors[].name. Same code space as contracts/common ErrorCode.

envelope.binary: A binary WebSocket message from the server starts with an 8-byte big-endian unsigned integer, the id of the Request it belongs to; the rest is the payload. The server sends it before the Response with that id. Binary messages from the client are not defined yet.

domains.description: Connection setup. Authentication: an Authorization: Bearer header (RFC 6750) on the WebSocket upgrade, or auth as the first message. Until authenticated, every other message is rejected with UNAUTHENTICATED. A token in the URL query string is not accepted. Both paths use the Authenticator SPI.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Authenticates the connection when the upgrade carried no Authorization header. On failure the server answers UNAUTHENTICATED and closes the connection.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Opaque token as issued, in RFC 6750 b64token syntax; the same string as in Authorization: Bearer.

commands.name: hello
commands.description: Version negotiation (docs/04-adp.md section 9). Compatible when the majors match, and for 0.x versions also the minors (semver caret rule); otherwise UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

domains.description: CDP-style target model in flat session mode. Instances are top-level targets; display, window, process and webview targets sit beneath an instance. Attaching returns a sessionId; authorization is checked at attach.

types.description: Opaque session ID returned by attachToTarget.

properties.name: attached
properties.description: Whether this connection is attached to the target.

properties.name: parentId
properties.description: The target this one sits beneath. Absent for instance targets.

commands.name: getTargets
commands.description: Without a session: the instance targets. In a session: the targets beneath the session's target.

commands.name: attachToTarget
commands.description: Attaches to a target. Instance targets: without a session. Other targets: in the session of the target they sit beneath. Denied by the Authorizer: POLICY_DENIED. Gone: TARGET_GONE.

types.description: Opaque node ID. Stable for the node's lifetime and never reused.
The frame that trees, screenshots and events refer to.

properties.name: vsyncId
properties.description: Choreographer vsync ID (app side). Decimal string.

properties.name: sfFrame
properties.description: SurfaceFlinger frame number (composition side). Decimal string.

types.description: Rectangle in display physical pixels, screen coordinates.
A node of the unified tree.

properties.name: webviewTargetId
properties.description: CDP target reference when the node is a WebView.

types.description: Selector string. Grammar and semantics: contracts/adp/selectors/selector.ebnf. Conformance cases: contracts/adp/selectors/conformance.json. Syntax error or unknown engine: INVALID_PARAMS.
Tree diff format. nodeOps: TreeOp operations on node IDs. Extension point: a value the server does not know is rejected with INVALID_PARAMS.
Changed fields of a node. Absent: unchanged. null: the optional field is cleared. id and children never appear here; children change through insert, remove and move.
One nodeOps operation. Applied in array order; a parent is inserted before its children.

variants.description: Inserts node with its subtree under parentId, right after previousSiblingId, or as the first child when previousSiblingId is absent.
Removes the node with its subtree. Removed IDs are never reused.
Moves the node with its subtree under parentId, right after previousSiblingId, or as the first child when previousSiblingId is absent. The node keeps its ID.

commands.name: getTree
commands.description: Returns the unified tree for one frame.

events.name: treeMutated
events.description: The tree changed from baseFrameId to frameId (format nodeOps). A client whose current frame is not baseFrameId re-fetches with getTree; ops are never applied to another base.

types.description: When an input command resolves. dispatched: once the input is dispatched (no frameId). frameCommitted: at the first frame committed after the input took effect. idle: when the UI is idle; the idle criterion and the default timeout are server settings.

commands.name: click
commands.description: Clicks a node. Gone: NODE_GONE. Cannot act: NOT_ACTIONABLE. resolveOn idle past idleTimeoutMs: TIMEOUT (the input was already dispatched).

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

commands.name: longClick
commands.description: Long-clicks a node. Errors as for click.

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

commands.name: dispatchTouch
commands.description: One touch event in coordinates. resolveOn idle past idleTimeoutMs: TIMEOUT (the input was already dispatched).

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

commands.name: insertText
commands.description: Inserts text at the current input focus. resolveOn idle past idleTimeoutMs: TIMEOUT (the input was already dispatched).

parameters.name: idleTimeoutMs
parameters.description: For resolveOn idle. Default: a server setting.

commands.name: captureScreenshot
commands.description: Captures exactly the requested frame, or FRAME_EXPIRED; no other frame is substituted.

parameters.name: transfer
parameters.description: binary: the image is a binary message (envelope.binary). base64: the image is in data. Default: binary.

types.description: Opaque ID of an upload on this connection.
Tagged union on kind. A server rejects a kind it does not know with INVALID_PARAMS.

variants.description: Bytes uploaded over this ADP connection.
